description: Department of Census and Statistics - Appointed Commissioner, Deputy Commissioner and Assistant Commissioner of Census for the each District
categorisation: This gazette contains both a named government official (Hon. Mahinda Rajapaksa as Minister of Economic Policies and Plan Implementation) AND detailed descriptions of the specific responsibilities and appointments being made under the Census Ordinance. It includes both the "who" (the Minister) and the "what" (appointing District Secretaries as Commissioners of Census and other officers as Deputy/Assistant Commissioners for specific districts and divisions), making it a Hybrid Gazette according to the classification rules.
